data.title: 爱西亚 · 卧室烛光下的圣洁白袍
data.description: 静谧寝室内点着几支柔和的香氛蜡烛，月光与烛火交织出安宁的暖色。爱西亚换上一袭纯白棉质轻纱睡裙，双手交叠放在胸前捧着小巧的银质十字架。金黄色的柔顺短发在烛光下熠熠生辉，翠绿的眼眸盛满了对心上人的无限依恋与毫无杂质的纯洁信任，脸颊微红，宛如降临凡间的小小圣女。
data.location: quiet candlelit bedroom with fluttering sheer curtains
data.action: sitting peacefully on bed in white cotton nightdress, hands clasped gently over chest holding cross, candlelight reflecting in soft green eyes, pure innocent blushing smile
data.lighting: warm flickering candlelight creating an angelic halo of golden light
data.mood: serene saintly devotion, pure innocent spiritual beauty
data.promptProse: Sitting quietly on a bed surrounded by warm candlelight, Asia Argento wears a simple white cotton nightdress. Her hands rest over her heart holding a cross pendant, smiling with pure, angelic innocence.
data.animaCaption: Asia sitting peacefully on a candlelit bed in a white nightdress with a cross pendant.
